184-1308-4682.easyPrerequisites: You have at least three opponents.
184-1308-4682.notablePrerequisites: Opponents are unable to pay for Smothering Tithe's trigger.
184-1308-4682.description:
Activate Faerie Mastermind by paying {3}{U}, causing each player to draw a card.
Smothering Tithe triggers for each opponent you have, creating at least six Treasure tokens due to Anointed Procession.
Activate four Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {3}{U}.
Repeat.

3508-3769-4879.easyPrerequisites:
Blim does not have summoning sickness and cannot be blocked by an opponent.
You control a destructible land that enters the battlefield untapped and can tap to produce at least {1}.
3508-3769-4879.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent with Blim.
When Blim deals combat damage, Blim triggers, causing (among other effects) target opponent to gain control of Price of Glory.
During an opponent's turn, activate any land by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Price of Glory triggers, destroying the land.
Sacred Ground triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

141-2034-5100.easyPrerequisites: There's a creature card in your graveyard.
141-2034-5100.description:
Cast Return Upon the Tide by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, targeting Return Upon the Tide.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Naru Meha, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying Return Upon the Tide
Resolve the Return Upon the Tide copy, returning Naru Meha from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

141-1070-3899.easyPrerequisites: There's a creature card in your graveyard.
141-1070-3899.description:
Cast Rise Again by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, targeting Rise Again.
Holding priority, activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing Naru Meha, putting a charge counter on Spawning Pit.
Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying Rise Again
Resolve the Rise Again copy, returning Naru Meha from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

uses.n: Yarus, Roar of the Old Gods

339-677-4247-5434.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing Jegantha.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

1445-2267-4871-8095.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in hand and a creature card in your graveyard.
1445-2267-4871-8095.description:
Activate Tortured Existence by paying {B} and discarding a creature card, returning another creature card from your graveyard to your hand.
Tormod triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

1170-5131-6495-7693--202.easyPrerequisites:
Armor Wars' second chapter ability has resolved this turn.
You haven't cast an artifact spell using Muldrotha this turn.
1170-5131-6495-7693--202.description:
Cast the artifact from your graveyard using Muldrotha's ability by paying {0} due to Armor Wars.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Muldrotha, allowing you to use its ability again this turn.
Resolve the artifact spell.
Activate Evereth by sacrificing the artifact, putting a +1/+1 counter on Evereth
Repeat.
1170-5131-6495-7693--202.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

3756-5413-6871-7115--44.description:
Cast the artifact by paying {0}.
Toph, Hardheaded Teacher triggers, earthbending Izzet Boilerworks.
Resolve the artifact spell.
Activate Trenching Steed by sacrificing Izzet Boilerworks.
When Izzet Boilerworks dies, Toph, Hardheaded Teach triggers, returning Izzet Boilerworks from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Izzet Boilerworks enters, it triggers, returning the artifact cast in step 1 from the battlefield to your hand, as it's a land due to Toph, the First Metalbender.
Resolve the Trenching Steed ability
Repeat.

549-5231-6871--183.manaNeeded: {0} plus the cost of the creature that earthbends
549-5231-6871--183.description:
Cast the earthbending creature by paying its mana cost.
When you cast that spell, you lose 1 life and create a 2/2 artifact creature token.
The earthbending creature enters as an artifact land creature due to Biotransference and Toph.
When that creature enters, it earthbends, causing itself to become a land creature with haste, putting at least one +1/+1 counter on itself, and creating a delayed triggered ability.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing that creature, adding {R}.
When that creature dies, the delayed ability from step 4 triggers, causing it to return to the battlefield tapped as an artifact land creature.
Repeat from step 3 any number of times.

575-1794-5686.notablePrerequisites: You have at least one black card in hand.
575-1794-5686.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Ruthless Ripper
When Ruthless Ripper dies, Yedora triggers, returning Ruthless Ripper from your graveyard to the battlefield face down as a Forest land.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability
Activate Ruthless Ripper's morph ability by revealing a black card from your hand, turning it face up.
Repeat.

1887-3484-5391-7824.notablePrerequisites: You have at least three energy counters.
1887-3484-5391-7824.description:
Activate Automated Assembly Line by paying {E}{E}{E}, creating two tapped 3/3 Robot artifact creature tokens.
When the Robots enter the battlefield, Decoction Module triggers twice, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}{E}.
Repeat.

3532-5078-7742-7753.easyPrerequisites: There is a removable counter on a creature you control.
3532-5078-7742-7753.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Machinesmith Automaton triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Machinesmith Automaton.
Repeat.

3532-5078-6822-7356.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Lyla triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Longshot triggers, dealing 2 damage to each opponent.
Repeat.

2366-3688-5295-5702.easyPrerequisites:
You have a land card in hand.
You are able to play a land this turn.
2366-3688-5295-5702.description:
Play a land. When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
When the Dryad Arbor token enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers. Holding priority, activate the Dryad Arbor token by tapping it, adding {G}.
Zhur-Taa Ancient triggers, adding {G}.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more charge counters on it

539-2734-3899-4365-4552.description:
Animate Spawning Pit using Cyberdrive Awakener.
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by removing two charge counters from it, creating two creature tokens.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability twice by sacrificing the creature tokens, putting two charge counters on it.
Repeat from step 2.

11-2365-6555-7089.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block and kill Fire Lord Azula
11-2365-6555-7089.description:
Declare Fire Lord Azula as an attacker, triggering its firebending ability, adding {R}{R}.
Holding priority, cast Expropriate by paying its mana cost.
Fire Lord Azula's second ability triggers, copying Expropriate.
Holding priority, cast Narset's Reversal by paying {U}{U}, targeting the original Expropriate spell.
Fire Lord Azula's second ability triggers, copying Narset's Reversal, targeting the original Narset's Reversal.
Resolve the copy of Narset's Reversal, causing you to copy Narset's Reversal targeting the original Expropriate spell, and then return the original Narset's Reversal to your hand.
Resolve the copy of Narset's Reversal, copying Expropriate and returning the original Expropriate to your hand.
Resolve both copies of Expropriate from steps 3 and 7, causing you to take at least two extra turns after this one.
Repeat during your last extra turn.

512-4002-4241.easyPrerequisites: You control three or more lands that share a name.
512-4002-4241.description:
Activate Karn twice by paying {2}, causing Halo Fountain and Sceptre of Eternal Glory to become a creature.
Activate Sceptre of Eternal Glory by tapping it, adding {W}{W}{W}.
Activate Halo Fountain's second ability by paying {W}{W}, tapping it, and then untapping it and Sceptre of Eternal Glory, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat from step 2.
512-4002-4241.notes: With the excess mana, you can use it on Halo Fountain's first ability, tapping and untapping it to create creature tokens.

539-6620-7037.description:
Cast Toph by paying its mana cost plus commander tax if applicable
When Toph enters, its earthbend ability triggers, causing it to earthbend itself as it is a Forest due to Ashaya.
Activate Sylvan Safekeeper by sacrificing Toph
When Toph dies, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Toph enters, its earthbend ability triggers, causing it to earthbend itself as it is a Forest due to Ashaya.
Repeat from step 3.
Resolve the Sylvan Safekeeper ability.

803-3767-3918-7013.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three creatures
803-3767-3918-7013.description:
Activate Trazyn using White Lotus Tile's ability by tapping it, adding at least three mana of any color.
Activate Trazyn by paying {2}, untapping it.
Repeat.

1477-1778-5220-6900.description:
Activate Extruder by sacrificing Memnite
When Memnite dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Memnite from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Extruder ability.
Cast Memnite from the top of your library by paying 0 life.
Repeat.

2173-3025-4905-5220.description:
Activate Fanatical Firebrand by tapping and sacrificing it.
When Fanatical Firebrand dies, Mortuary and Bastion of Remembrance trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Fanatical Firebrand from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Bastion of Remembrance trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Fanatical Firebrand ability.
Cast Fanatical Firebrand from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

1170-3200-4708-6862.easyPrerequisites: One of the artifacts must be in your hand, while the other is either in your graveyard or in your library.
1170-3200-4708-6862.description:
Cast the artifact in your hand by paying its mana cost.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Delivery Moogle.
When Delivery Moogle enters, it triggers, searching your library or graveyard for the other artifact and putting it into your hand.
Activate the artifact cast in step 1 by sacrificing it.
Repeat.

1168-1651-5921-6756-6850.easyPrerequisites: You control a land that enters the battlefield untapped and that can tap to produce at least {1}.
1168-1651-5921-6756-6850.notablePrerequisites:
Hearthhull has two or more charge counters on it.
Fractured Realm is unlocked.
1168-1651-5921-6756-6850.description:
Activate a land by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Activate Hearthhull by paying {1}, tapping it and sacrificing a land.
If Hearthhull has eight or more charge counters on it, it triggers, causing each opponent to lose 2 life.
Resolve the Hearthhull ability, causing you to draw two cards and allowing you to play an additional land this turn.
Play the land from your graveyard.
When the land enters the battlefield, Toggo triggers twice due to Fractured Realm, creating two artifact tokens.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping the artifact tokens, untapping Hearthhull.
Repeat.

856-3899-4321-5631.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Food.
856-3899-4321-5631.description:
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing a Food, returning Cauldron Familiar to the battlefield from your graveyard.
Cauldron Familiar and Skeleton Crew trigger.
Resolve the Skeleton Crew trigger, creating a token and a Food token.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Repeat

2511-2781-2947.description:
Cast Felidar Guardian by paying {3}{W}.
When Felidar Guardian enters the battlefield, it triggers, targeting Vesperlark.
Holding priority, activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Felidar Guardian.
Resolve the Felidar Guardian trigger, blinking Vesperlark.
When Vesperlark leaves the battlefield, it triggers, returning Felidar Guardian from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

1168-1651-2499-4935-6756.easyPrerequisites: You control a land that enters the battlefield untapped and that can tap to produce at least {1}.
1168-1651-2499-4935-6756.notablePrerequisites: Hearthhull has two or more charge counters on it.
1168-1651-2499-4935-6756.description:
Activate a land by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Activate Hearthhull by paying {1}, tapping it and sacrificing a land.
If Hearthhull has eight or more charge counters on it, it triggers, causing each opponent to lose 2 life.
Resolve the Hearthhull ability, causing you to draw two cards and allowing you to play an additional land this turn.
Play the land from your graveyard.
When the land enters the battlefield, Toggo triggers twice due to Yarok, creating two artifact tokens.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping the artifact tokens, untapping Hearthhull.
Repeat.

628-2921-6487.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Canker Abomination.
When Canker Abomination dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Canker Abomination enters the battlefield, it triggers, putting a number of -1/-1 counters on it equal to the number of creatures an opponent controls.
If the opponent had seven or more creatures, Canker Abomination will die as a state-based action due to having 0 or less toughness. If this occurs, repeat steps 2 through 4 infinitely.
Otherwise, resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability, and repeat from step 1.

1617-2719-4831-4983-5358.notablePrerequisites:
You control a permanent that can tap to produce at least {G}.
Sakashima of a Thousand Faces on the battlefield as a copy of Bellowing Aegisaur.
1617-2719-4831-4983-5358.description:
Activate a mana-producing permanent you control by tapping it, adding at least {G}.
Activate Wayta by paying {G} and tapping it, causing Cacophodon and Bellowing Aegisaur to fight each other, with each only taking 1 damage due to Temple Altisaur.
Cacophodon and Bellowing Aegisaur trigger twice.
Resolve both Bellowing Aegisaur triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on each creature you control.
Resolve both Cacophodon triggers, untapping the mana-producing permanent and Wayta.
Repeat from step 2, alternating between having Cacophodon fight Bellowing Aegisaur and Sakashima of a Thousand Faces to ensure neither dies due to lethal damage.

2440-4183-4730-5115.notablePrerequisites:
Saheeli does not have summoning sickness.
{U}{R} available, plus an additional {U}{R} if you control less than three creatures that share a creature type with Sparring Mummy
2440-4183-4730-5115.description:
Activate Saheeli by paying {U}{R} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Sparring Mummy with haste.
When the token Sparring Mummy enters the battlefield, it and Mana Echoes trigger.
Resolve the Sparring Mummy trigger, untapping Saheeli.
Holding priority, if you control less than four creatures that share a creature type with Sparring Mummy, repeat steps 1 through 3 one additional time.
Resolve all Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C} for each creature you control that shares a creature type with Sparring Mummy for each trigger resolved this way.
Activate Gemstone Array twice by paying {4}, putting two charge counters on it.
Activate Gemstone Array's second ability twice by removing two charge counters from it, adding {U}{R}.
Repeat.

uses.n: Grist, Voracious Larva // Grist, the Plague Swarm

1887-3305-4050-5926.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Body Launderer, adding {G}.
When Body Launderer dies, its second ability triggers, returning Grist, Voracious Larva from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Grist, Voracious Larva enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to pay {G} to exile it and return it to the battlefield as Grist, the Plague Swarm with six loyalty counters due to Vorinclex.
Activate Grist, the Plague Swarm's third loyalty ability by removing six loyalty counters from it.
Grist, the Plague Swarm is put into your graveyard as a state-based action due to having zero loyalty.
Resolve the Grist, the Plague Swarm ability, creating a token copy of each creature card in your graveyard that is a 1/1 Insect.
When the Grist, Voracious Larva token enters the battlefield, it triggers for each token created this way. Choose not to pay for any of the triggers.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Grist, Voracious Larva token, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat from step 1, sacrificing a Body Launderer token instead.

864-2639-3254-3967-4871.manaNeeded: {4}{G/W}{B}{B} plus enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable
864-2639-3254-3967-4871.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one other non-Human creature.
864-2639-3254-3967-4871.description:
Cast Nethroi either from your hand or from the command zone for its mutate cost by paying {4}{G/W}{B}{B} plus commander tax, if applicable, putting it on top of a non-Human creature you control.
When Nethroi enters the battlefield, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Yahenni by sacrificing Nethroi.
When Nethroi dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Resolve the Yahenni ability, giving it indestructible until end of turn.
Resolve the Nethroi trigger from step 2, returning Eternal Witness and Mitotic Slime from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Eternal Witness enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Nethroi from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate Yahenni twice by sacrificing Eternal Witness and Mitotic Slime.
When Eternal Witness and Mitotic Slime die, Pitiless Plunderer triggers twice and Mitotic Slime triggers once.
Resolve both Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating two Treasure artifact tokens.
Resolve the Mitotic Slime trigger, creating two 2/2 Ooze creature tokens.
Resolve both Yahenni abilities, giving it indestructible until end of turn.
Activate Yahenni twice by sacrificing two Oozes.
When the Oozes die, they each trigger and Pitiless Plunderer triggers twice.
Resolve both Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating two Treasure artifact tokens.
Resolve both Ooze triggers, creating four 1/1 Ooze creature tokens.
Resolve both Yahenni abilities, giving it indestructible until end of turn.
Activate Yahenni twice by sacrificing two Oozes.
When the Oozes die, Pitiless Plunderer triggers twice, creating two Treasure artifact tokens.
Resolve both Yahenni abilities, giving it indestructible until end of turn.
Activate the seven Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {4}{G/W}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

868-2634-3351.description:
Cast Desperate Ritual by paying {1}{R} and choosing to pay {2}{R}{R} and reveal Through the Breach from your hand, adding Through the Breach's effects to Desperate Ritual.
Holding priority, activate Rootha by paying {2} and returning it to your hand, copying Desperate Ritual.
Resolve the copy of Desperate Ritual, adding {R}{R}{R} and putting Rootha from your hand onto the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

1467-2103-2499-3634.notablePrerequisites: You haven't copied a spell using Jin-Gitaxias this turn.
1467-2103-2499-3634.description:
Cast Capture of Jingzhou by paying {3}{U}{U}.
Jin-Gitaxias triggers, copying Capture of Jingzhou.
Holding priority, cast Venser by paying {2}{U}{U}.
When Venser enters the battlefield, it triggers twice, returning itself and the original Capture of Jingzhou to your hand from the battlefield and stack respectively.
Resolve the copy of Capture of Jingzhou, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

442-575-4050.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Ainok Survivalist, adding {1}.
When Ainok Survivalist dies, Yedora triggers, returning Ainok Survivalist from your graveyard to the battlefield face down as a Forest land.
Activate Ainok Survivalist by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Ainok Survivalist's megamorph ability by paying {1}{G}, turning it face up.
Ainok Surivialist triggers, destroying target artifact and/or enchantment an opponent controls.
Repeat.
You may also repeat this loop whenever an artifact and/or enchantment enters the battlefield under an opponent's control.

75-3575-4871.notablePrerequisites:
Aerie Ouphes does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
There is a creature with flying on the battlefield.
75-3575-4871.description:
Activate Aerie Ouphes by sacrificing it, targeting any creature with flying.
When Aerie Ouphes dies, its persist ability and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Aerie Ouphes trigger, returning it to the battlefield from your graveyard with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B/G}.
Activate Quillspike by paying {B/G} and removing the -1/-1 counter from Aerie Ouphes, giving Quillspike +3/+3 until end of turn.
Repeat.

1124-2032-2034-4450-5082.description:
Activate Garruk's first loyalty ability by putting a loyalty counter on it, creating two 2/2 Wolf creature tokens.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing the Wolves, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
When the Wolves die, they trigger, putting two loyalty counters on each Garruk planeswalker you control.
Activate The Chain Veil by paying {4} and tapping it, allowing an extra activation of your planeswalkers' loyalty abilities this turn.
Activate Kiora by removing zero loyalty counters from it, untapping The Chain Veil.
Repeat.

799-1164-2056.manaNeeded: {5}{U}{U}{U/R}{U/R} each odd-numbered turn, with {4}{U}{U} available each even-numbered turn
799-1164-2056.description:
Cast Karn's Temporal Sundering by paying {4}{U}{U}.
Saheeli triggers, creating a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Resolve Karn's Temporal Sundering, causing you to take an extra turn after this one, return Saheeli from the battlefield to your hand if Saheeli has fewer than three loyalty counters, and exile Karn's Temporal Sundering.
Cast Saheeli by paying {1}{U/R}{U/R} if it's in your hand.
Activate Saheeli by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing the Servo to become a copy of Mirror of Fate until end of turn.
Activate the Servo by tapping and sacrificing it, choosing Karn's Temporal Sundering and up to six other cards face up in exile, then exiling your library and putting the chosen cards on top of your library, with Karn's Temporal Sundering being the top most card.
Move to your next turn, drawing Karn's Temporal Sundering during your draw step.
Repeat.

2713-3325-4277.notablePrerequisites: Xantcha on the battlefield under an opponent's control.
2713-3325-4277.description:
Activate Xantcha for {1}, drawing a card and causing its controller to lose 2 life.
Activate Cadaverous Bloom, exiling a card from your hand and adding {B}{B} or {G}{G}.
Activate Xantcha twice using the mana generated, drawing 2 cards and losing Xantcha's controller 4 life.
Activate Cadaverous Bloom exiling a card from your hand adding {B}{B} or {G}{G}.
Repeat from step 3.
If the player controlling Xantcha reaches a point where they only have 1 or 2 life remaining, you may hold priority and activate her any number of times before the player dies and she is exiled to draw as many of the remaining cards in your library as you wish.
